## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem this change solves and what happens after it.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and their results. Name the operating systems actually tested.

## Screenshots or fixtures

For UI changes, add before/after screenshots. For document behavior, use minimal synthetic files and explain what was verified.

- [ ] Original documents remain intact and existing outputs are not overwritten.
- [ ] Relevant tests passed; unverified platforms are identified.
- [ ] New UI strings use resource IDs; language placeholders are preserved.
- [ ] Documentation describes behavior and limitations accurately.
- [ ] No private documents, credentials, certificates or unrelated generated files are included.
